bindings.rationale: The varying path segment is the resource ID handled by the source idPath/idSegment helper; the HTTP verb and route template are matched to actual registered domain operations. The annotation identifies parameterized source traffic, not successful authorization, persistence or E2E execution. Conditional quote creation/copy and update, when present, remain distinct POST collection and PATCH entity branches.
resolves: Dynamic URL/method requires runtime contract validation.

bindings.rationale: The opportunities view delegates to the collection helper with a literal resource key. It loads scoped records and customer choices, then creates or version-updates the selected resource through editForm. Opportunities additionally load approved-contract choices. Each operation is linked to its actual registered backend policy.
resolves: No literal endpoint resolved; inspect shared/dynamic dispatch before claiming backend completion.
